Groal the Great: health, attacks and hits to kill

A boss fight in Hollow Knight: Silksong against Groal the Great, in Bilewater. The Hunter's Journal says: "Chief and chaplain of the Stilkin, forever raging against the Citadel that chokes their caves and sees them suffer."

650 health.

With the Needle alone (a Hunter's Crest with no Tools or modifiers), a slash deals 9, 11, 13, 15 and 19 with the Needle, Sharpened Needle, Shining Needle, Hivesteel Needle and Pale Steel Needle: that's 73, 60, 50, 44 and 35 slashes. The damage modifiers are this boss's own: each enemy takes different damage from each upgrade.

With the Hunter's Crest, a slash every 0.41 s (the game's own pace, from its files): with the Pale Steel Needle, 13.9 s of nonstop slashing.

Attacks, as the wiki names them (the game doesn't): Acid Spit, Great Inhale (2 masks), Spike Ball Ambush, Stilkin Ambush, Vengeful Soul.

Staggered after 15 hits.

Reward: Seeker's Soul.

This page opens the damage calculator with this boss picked: with your save or your build, each of your attacks' damage, how many it takes, and what each of its attacks does to you.

Questions

What is Groal the Great's health in Silksong?

650 health.

How many hits does it take to beat Groal the Great?

It depends on your Needle and your Tools: with the Needle alone, from 73 slashes with the Needle to 35 with the Pale Steel Needle. For your exact build, open the calculator on this page.
